title: Two people, four seasons
decides: Do people described in words stay the same between clips? One person opens and closes; another has the two seasons between.
setting: A gentle short film in natural light, soft colour, steady camera, shallow depth of field.

subjects.words: Mara, a woman in her thirties with short curly red hair, round gold glasses and a mustard-yellow wool coat
Theo, a tall man in his sixties with a white beard, a navy flat cap and a long grey scarf

beats.text: Spring. Mara stands under a cherry tree in blossom, looks at the camera and holds out a hand as pink petals fall.
Summer. Theo walks barefoot along a bright beach at the edge of the waves and tips his cap to the sun.
Autumn. Theo sits on a park bench among red and orange leaves and catches a falling leaf.
Winter. Mara stands in falling snow, pulls her coat closed, smiles at the camera and waves goodbye.

checks: Spring, summer, autumn, winter, in order, each once
Mara, Theo, Theo, Mara: the right person in each season
Mara is the same person in spring and winter
Theo is the same person in summer and autumn
No season is left in the next season's frames
